note: 14 Nov (the owner: "lesson scripts, build them. use a rental."). A small trial of the lesson kit (docs/TOOL-LESSONS-PLAN.md), only the parts that don't depend on the tool shapes still being picked. The card serves the STOCK Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (never the old Bobert, the owner: it was trained on poisoned data); this PC's lesson writer talks to it. 1) Doctored GPT-OSS v5 failures: 40 failures, 3 look-alikes each plus the failure itself, 2 routes, about 1 in 4 with a second try, base Bob and Sherlock (to see whether a style holds on tool lessons). 2) Look it up when unsure: 60 seeds from Riker's stock answers and their odds (search-pairs.mjs, run on this PC first), base Bob. Every lesson reviewed by the teacher; the ledger then drops anything that is a test or a repeat. Nothing is trained or uploaded; the lessons stay on this PC for the owner to look at. About 2.5 h on a 48 GB card. Caps 3.5 h / $2.50, only on the owner's typed go in the lesson-sets thread.

benchmark.note: one brain: the stock Qwen as the lesson teacher. The first command is the smoke test: 3 failures, 1 look-alike each, base only; the run is stopped by hand in the first minutes if it makes nothing.

models.name: qwen-stock
commands: node lesson-doctor.mjs --url {{url}} --seeds out/lesson-kit-trial/seeds-v5.jsonl --never out/lesson-kit-trial/never.jsonl --name lkt-smoke --limit 3 --alike 1 --routes 1 --retry 0 --versions base
node lesson-doctor.mjs --url {{url}} --seeds out/lesson-kit-trial/seeds-v5.jsonl --never out/lesson-kit-trial/never.jsonl --name lkt-v5 --limit 40 --alike 3 --routes 2 --versions base,sherlock

node write-lessons.mjs --url {{url}} --model teacher --dir lkt-v5-sherlock --from-ideas --count 160 --review --think all --tag "Think: Sherlock" --persona forge/plans/think-sherlock.txt --parallel 6 --hours 0.6

prep: The owner, 14 Nov 6:28 AM: "prep on rental". The steps that make the trial's inputs run inside the rental, as its first commands; before renting, only the input files are put in place (no runs).

Inputs put in place first: out/lesson-kit-trial/seeds-v5.jsonl (the traced v5 failures), out/lesson-kit-trial/never.jsonl (Riker's 310 stock items, tonight's interview turns, tool-score held-out chats), and {{riker_answers}} filled in with the path of Riker's stock answers that carry odds.

After the run: node lesson-ledger.mjs --check out/<each set> --ledger out/lesson-ledger.jsonl --never out/lesson-kit-trial/never.jsonl --out out/<set>-checked, then node audit-lessons.mjs on each checked set.

publish.note: Nothing is uploaded from this run.
